concept: alchemist plus summoner fantasy semantic pixel test
negative_en: cartoon style, unrealistic hands, illustration look, broken facial features, plastic-looking skin, excessive HDR, over-processed retouching
prompt_en: Photorealistic fantasy process-documentation photograph in a copper-and-glass heatwork laboratory. Image 1 guides visible appearance for an original adult fictional woman; her facial appearance and long dark wavy hair are guided by Image 1. Preserve the reference-visible facial structure, hairline, dark wavy hair texture, and natural makeup balance. Use a medium-wide three-quarter view beside a connected crucible, retort, condenser, and receiver, with readable working hands under shared furnace and receiver light. Show an alchemist performing a visible material transmutation: one practitioner actively controls heat flow or material contact at the crucible; retort crucible vessel and transfer path form one connected apparatus system under active heat; input and output material states remain simultaneously comparable in one view; color texture phase or crystal structure changes at one bounded transition zone inside glass; condensate slag sediment vapor or heat discoloration traces the process on the stained bench. Dark slurry enters as crystalline fluid collects downstream through an amber-to-clear gradient. In that causal frame, show a summoner causing a distinct entity to arrive: one living operator performs a visible controlling action beside the apparatus; one bounded source or threshold anchors the arrival inside the receiver mouth; one separately embodied entity emerges rather than duplicating the operator from that receiver; gesture gaze and entity orientation create a directional operator-to-arrival relation across the laboratory; dust light shadow or displaced objects respond locally to the arrival around its feet. One separately embodied glass-and-vapor entity emerges into the room toward her raised hand, with a contact shadow and outward-pushed droplets.
